props.label: OEE
props.visualizationTransform:
(
  $redPercent := $coalesce([redPercent, 85]);
  $yellowPercent := $coalesce([yellowPercent, 90]);
{
    "chart": {
      "caption": caption,
      "animation": false,
      "defaultCenterLabel": $string($round(value)) & "%",
      "decimals": "0",
      "startingAngle": 90,
      "centerLabelFontSize": 18,
      "showHoverEffect": 0,
      "plotHoverEffect": 0,
      "numberSuffix": "%",
      "pieRadius": "70%",
      "showLegend": false,
      "enableRotation": 0,
      "enableSlicing": 0,
      "showShadow": 1,
      "bgColor": "#FFFFFF",
      "captionFontSize": 20,
      "doughnutRadius": "75%",
      "chartLeftMargin": 4,
      "chartRightMargin": 4,
      "chartTopMargin": 4,
      "chartBottomMargin": 4,
      "centerLabelColor": "#666666"
    },
    "data": [
      {
        "label": caption,
        "value": value,
        "color": value < $redPercent ? "#f44336"
          : value < $yellowPercent ? "#ffa000"
          : "#43a047",
        "showLabel": "0",
        "showValue": "0"
      },
      {
        "label": "",
        "value": $sum(100-value),
        "color": "#808080",
        "showLabel": "0",
        "showValue": "0"
      }
    ]
  }
)
